method.pin_to_net: probe_net(point) on the pin's own conductor layers -- a pin and the wire it joins are never on the same layer, they are joined by a via instance (plan sec.6.5)
method.probe_points: A4 positions_um (label origins), transformed by the B1 affine map; never a bounding-rect centre
method.position_layers: each position is probed only on the pairs whose shape contains it, so it cannot land on another net's wire
method.net_identity: KLayout cluster_id -- stable within one engine configuration
method.disagreement: a pin whose positions land on more than one net is a defect and is recorded in conflicts; the winner is the cluster with the most agreeing positions, ties broken by lowest cluster id
method.supply_note: supply pins are modelled and probed like any other pin; 972 of them have no net for the two reasons A5 predicted
